items.title: Visiting Taiwan w/ Jensen Huang | Lex Fridman
items.author: Lex Fridman
items.content:
<article>I've been traveling the world a bit. One of the most incredible experiences was getting to visit Taiwan with Jensen Huang. It was wild 🤯 Huge crowds, insanely good street food at night markets, and of course a lot of good conversations across many days. I caught some of it on video, this is it.
Thanks for watching. Love you all ❤ Check out our sponsors: https://lexfridman.com/sponsors/mv589-sb
